```yaml
name: Performance Benchmark

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened]

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

permissions:
  contents: read
  pull-requests: write

jobs:
  benchmark:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout PR branch
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          path: pr

      - name: Checkout main branch
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: main
          path: main

      - name: Set up Node
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies (PR)
        run: npm ci
        working-directory: pr

      - name: Benchmark PR branch
        id: benchmark_pr
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cd pr
          npm run build
          times=()
          for i in {1..7}; do
            if [ $i -le 2 ]; then
              time -p npm pack > /dev/null 2>&1
            else
              t=$( { time -p npm pack > /dev/null 2>&1; } 2>&1 | grep real | awk '{print $2}' )
              times+=("$t")
            fi
            rm -f *.tgz
          done
          sorted=$(printf "%s\n" "${times[@]}" | sort -n)
          median=$(printf "%s\n" "${sorted}" | sed -n '3p')
          echo "PR_MEDIAN=$median" >> $GITHUB_ENV
        shell: bash

      - name: Install dependencies (main)
        run: npm ci
        working-directory: main

      - name: Benchmark main branch
        id: benchmark_main
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cd main
          npm run build
          times=()
          for i in {1..7}; do
            if [ $i -le 2 ]; then
              time -p npm pack > /dev/null 2>&1
            else
              t=$( { time -p npm pack > /dev/null 2>&1; } 2>&1 | grep real | awk '{print $2}' )
              times+=("$t")
            fi
            rm -f *.tgz
          done
          sorted=$(printf "%s\n" "${times[@]}" | sort -n)
          median=$(printf "%s\n" "${sorted}" | sed -n '3p')
          echo "MAIN_MEDIAN=$median" >> $GITHUB_ENV
        shell: bash

      - name: Compute benchmark results
        id: compute
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          pr=${{ env.PR_MEDIAN }}
          main=${{ env.MAIN_MEDIAN }}
          diff=$(awk "BEGIN{print $pr - $main}")
          diff_abs=$(awk "BEGIN{print ($pr - $main) >= 0 ? $pr - $main : -($pr - $main)}")
          diff_percent=$(awk "BEGIN{print ($pr - $main)/$main*100}")
          sign=$(awk "BEGIN{print ($pr - $main) >= 0 ? \"+\" : \"-\"}")
          printf "DIFF_SEC=%.2f\nDIFF_PERCENT=%.2f\nDIFF_SIGN=%s\n" "$diff_abs" "$diff_percent" "$sign" >> $GITHUB_ENV
        shell: bash

      - name: Post benchmark comment
        uses: thollander/actions-comment-pull-request@e4a76dd2b0a3c2027c3fd84147a67c22ee4c90fa
        with:
          message: |
            | | Time |
            |---|---:|
            | PR branch | ${{ env.PR_MEDIAN }}s |
            | main branch | ${{ env.MAIN_MEDIAN }}s |
            | **Diff** | **${{ env.DIFF_SIGN }}${{ env.DIFF_SEC }}s (${{
            env.DIFF_PERCENT }}%)** |
          pr-number: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          comment-tag: perf-benchmark
          mode: replace
          create-if-not-exists: true
```
